title: When the Terminal Turns
author: O. M. Hartwell
blurb: Sable Oyelaran, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
